## Activity

During December 2020, North City Eye Clinic completed 259 captures. This activity represents the total number of image sets submitted by the clinic during the reporting month. The figure should be reviewed alongside the image quality and grading information below to support routine monitoring of site operations.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.5. This measure should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance activity. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be identified and followed up through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 47 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 1 day. These results provide a summary of grading activity for North City Eye Clinic during December 2020. The site should continue to record operational issues and review image quality and grading performance as part of regular service monitoring.
